correctness.rationale: Depth-one propositional/vertical formulas identify each realized ordered pair of colours; if the top-row support E differs from its transpose, a depth-two horizontal diamond picks one row, hence 2|E| atoms. If E=E^T, matching ordered-pair labels across rows defines a modal bisimulation giving |E| atoms. The asymmetric support upper bound is sharply attained, explaining nonmonotonicity. Standard surjective occupancy yields exactly t!S(m,t) words per fixed t-type support, and transpose-invariant supports are counted by coefficients of (1+z)^q(1+z^2)^[q(q-1)/2]. The first missing ordered type gives the stated positive leading expectation correction. Independent direct refinement on all 526 nonempty supports for q=2,3 confirmed the atom-count dichotomy.
residual_risks: The exact law is for 2 rows, two S5-equivalence diamonds and fixed q=2^k; large-column expectation is with fixed q.
